body:
I think we should keep `jj` modes and a general `vcs` module as separate PRs.

For `git` in particular, repo discovery is also a bit more complex (e.g. it can discover bare repos), and a final version of this should support `GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES` for better performance.

Very much interested in `jj` support; for what it's worth, here are the info that I'd like to see in my prompt:
- The latest bookmark (`jj log -r 'heads(bookmarks()::@ & bookmarks())' --no-graph -T bookmarks`)
- `+` the current change id (maybe only if I'm not exactly on the tag) (`jj log -r '@ & ~bookmarks()' --no-graph -T 'commit_id.shortest()'`)

To give an update on this: I've actively restarted work on it this weekend, I've not been happy at all with what I had previously, I'm finishing the initial implementation and will update the MR soon.

My new approach is as follows:

```toml
format = "$vcs"

[git_branch]
# config

[pijul_channel]
# config

[vcs]
order = ["git", "pijul"]
git_modules = "$git_branch$git_state"
pijul_modules = "$pijul_channel"
# Same for other VCSes:
# hg_modules = "..."
# fossil_modules = "..."
```

It keeps individual VCSes modules accessible and configurable at the top level, but when using `$vcs` in `format`, it will directly replace `$vcs` by the modules in `vcs.<found vcs>_modules`. That's it. Nothing more. Any `$<name>` is replaced by the `<name>` module (the default configuration is all modules for that VCS, but I'm not going to limit it that way, it's both easier not to and it allows for custom modules to be added in)

There is no complicated formatting or stuff like this for example, I'm not even going to add any smarts like "not rediscovering repos for each VCS module" for now, I want a very simple implementation to make it easier to review and test for (they can easily be added in a follow up MR).

In the same vein, I'm not going to add JJ support in this MR since it's currently not in starship, but I'll make an MR to build on top of this one quickly.

One thing I would like recommendations/help on from more experience Starship contributors is testing. This new `vcs` module essentially directly forward to its underlying `<vcs>_modules` so it has extremely little logic by itself (and the little bit about discovering the repo's root I made sure to reuse elsewhere to be sure it was covered by existing tests).

I don't want to copy-paste all existing VCSes tests so I'm not sure what would be a good way to test this MR.
Took the time to write tests that cover everything so this MR is ready to go 🎉

> @matchai In general the changes LGTM. The main issue I see with the general approach in the PR is that independent styling of vcs segments is no longer possible (e.g. moving just branch names into `right_format`).

I wonder if it might be possible to solve this problem orthogonal to this PR by introducing named override versions of each module. I.e. by making the modules support being configured as `[vcs.foo]`, `[vcs.bar]` etc. with a similar approach to how `custom.foo` works.

Reverted the default config changes and added a documentation note to say why the module is not part of the default config as well as note it may change in the future.

I don't use right-aligned prompt at all and the current module (once I work on a Jujutsu follow-up) will handle my needs entirely but if merged and someone wants to take up the work, feel free to ask me questions :)
